comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and for confirming that a Store reinstall still installs 0.100.2. The update check in that version cannot parse the newer four-component release version; this was corrected by #49414. Because the affected updater cannot discover the newer release itself, please install the current release manually from the PowerToys releases page, then confirm whether subsequent update checks work. This report can be closed as handled by that fix.
